title: Qualify the AC1018 ACAD_LAYOUT dictionary through AC1024 output

independentReader.scope: Corroborates source identities and graph; emitted output evidence comes from the bound local writer, staged-byte inspector and fresh readback.

rootBinding.role: source entry role preserved by mapped-reference comparison

implementation.summary: After both LAYOUT OBJECTS and reciprocal BLOCK_RECORD inspectors succeed, transactionally qualify the captured ACAD_LAYOUT DICTIONARY identity with the three LAYOUT identities. The existing inspector freezes the source dictionary, verifies its unique NOD owner/key and emitted DICTIONARY identity/owner, decodes the complete staged output body, and compares all fields, entry names, mapped handles and entry roles. Qualification is published only with successful output transaction completion.
implementation.scopeBoundary: The NOD proof checks the unique ACAD_LAYOUT edge but not the full NOD body; NOD 0x0C remains unqualified. This does not qualify whole-source output or promote a format support claim.

failureAndRetry.negativeControl: For ASCII and Binary, corrupt Layout1's BLOCK_RECORD handle. Output is refused before destination replacement and the dictionary/layout qualification state remains at its pre-attempt value.
failureAndRetry.retry: Restore the source handle and retry on the same adapter. Both encodings publish output, qualify DICTIONARY 0x1A and the three LAYOUT identities, and freshly reimport the layout graph. The source STYLE 0xDF is renamed only in-memory by this bounded selector to reach the LAYOUT writer; its separate fail-closed contract is unchanged.
failureAndRetry.strictWholeSource: Still refused at 14/23 callback identities; the nine remaining identities are listed above. STYLE 0xDF remains an independent whole-source blocker.
